title: Kidney removal (nephrectomy)
what: The surgeon removes the whole kidney or only the part with a tumor. Often through small openings, sometimes through a cut.
why: Most often for a kidney tumor. Sometimes when a kidney does not work and causes problems.
duration: surgery usually takes 2 to 4 hours, with 3 to 7 days in hospital
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to stop and when
Allergies to medicines, latex, or iodine
High blood pressure, diabetes, or heart disease
How your other kidney works. Your doctor will check your tests
Medicines that can harm the kidneys. Your doctor will advise

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and sometimes a GP checkup. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthetist
prepare.text: Before surgery, an anesthetist will talk with you. Tell them about your health and medicines.

prepare.title: Food and water
prepare.text: Usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Kidney tests
prepare.text: Before surgery, both kidneys are checked, usually with a blood test and CT scan.

steps: You change, and an IV line is placed
A catheter is placed in your bladder
You are placed on your side
The surgeon removes the kidney or part of it
The wound is stitched. Sometimes a drain is placed
feel: Pain in the side and at the wounds. You will get painkillers
The bladder catheter is bothersome. It comes out after 1 to 2 days
after: You usually get up and walk on the first day
Drink water as your doctor says
No heavy lifting for a few weeks
Lab results usually come in 1 to 2 weeks
red_flags: Large clots in your urine, or very little urine
A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), or severe side pain
Calf pain, shortness of breath, or chest pain: call emergency services

faq.q: Can I live with one kidney?
faq.a: Yes. One healthy kidney copes. Keep checking your blood pressure and tests.

faq.q: Do I need a special diet?
faq.a: Usually not. Your doctor may advise less salt and avoiding some painkillers.

reminders.text: Kidney surgery tomorrow. Bring your CT scans and test results. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
